label: H3C S5130S-16S-PWR-EI
description: H3C S5130S-16S-PWR-EI 16-port PoE+ access switch: 12x 10/100/1000BASE-T PoE+ (30 W a port) plus 2x non-PoE 10/100/1000BASE-T, 2x 1G/10G SFP+ uplinks, 125 W PoE budget, 68 Gbps port switching capacity, 51 Mpps.

poe.note: 125 W total PoE power on 12 PoE+ ports (ports 13 and 14 carry no PoE), 30 W maximum a port. The vendor PoE summary table on the product page prints 120 W for this model while the hardware-information page and that page power row - MAX: AC 157 W (PoE 125 W) - both say 125 W; the 125 W figure is recorded here.

fabric.note: Port switching capacity 68 Gbps (14 x 1G + 2 x 10G, full duplex), forwarding capacity 51 Mpps.

notes: S5130S-EI common platform (Comware 7): box switching capacity 336 Gbps, 256 MB flash / 512 MB SDRAM, IRF2 stacking of up to 9 units, static routes plus RIP and OSPF, 802.1Q VLAN, LACP, STP/RSTP/MSTP, DHCP server, SNMPv1/v2c/v3, NETCONF/gRPC, web UI and CLI. Port layout and PoE totals from the vendor hardware-information page (https://www.h3c.com/en/Support/Resource_Center/EN/Switches/Catalog/S5130S/S5130S-EI/Technical_Documents/Product_Literature/Hardware_Information___Specifications/H3C_S5130S-EI_IG/202306/1867335_294551_0.htm); switching and forwarding figures from the vendor product page (https://www.h3c.com/en/Products_and_Solutions/InterConnect/Switches/Products/Campus_Network/Access/S5130/H3C_S5130S_EI/). Current software line is Comware 7 CMW710, release R6381 listed on the H3C resource centre for this series (https://www.h3c.com/en/Support/Resource_Center/EN/Switches/Catalog/S5130S/S5130S-EI/default.htm). Copper ports are numbered 1-14 with 13 and 14 plain gigabit (no PoE); the two cages are 1G/10G SFP+. The vendor PoE table rates this chassis 8 ports at 15.4 W or 4 at 30 W within the 125 W budget. Fanless, 300 x 260 x 43.6 mm, <= 2.5 kg. One serial console port plus one micro USB console port (the micro USB one wins when both are connected), 16 Gbps maximum stacking bandwidth.
